description: The single output of the research stage (pipeline/RESEARCH.md). Claude researches a topic and produces this dossier; tools/from-dossier.mjs turns it into a working app (topic.js + data stubs), and the build stage (pipeline/BUILD.md) fills the content targets. Every field the engine understands comes from here, so a new topic never requires engine changes.

contentTargets.description: What the build stage must produce. The builder works to these numbers; the validator reports against them.

domains.description: The app's study domains. Names are used verbatim in questions and cards. Convention: '<Track>: <Domain>' when the topic has multiple tracks.

duty.description: Blueprint duty letter this domain mostly serves, when duties exist.

track.description: Owning track id, when the domain belongs to one track.

tasks.description: Optional task list per duty letter: { "A": [{ "id": "A1", "name": "..." }] }. Questions cite these ids in their task field.

duties.description: Official blueprint per track, transcribed from the governing body's exam content outline. Weights are percent of the exam and should sum to 100 per track.

library.description: Document Library tab config, derived from sources with a localFile. Omit when nothing ships.

cert.description: Group heading, usually a track label or 'Shared'.

prompts.description: Chat prompts to run against the notebook to draft guides and explanations.

researchNotes.description: What was verified and how, what is gated or uncertain, and open questions for the human. Never silently drop a conflict between sources; record it here.

roadmap.description: Roadmap tab config: one checklist per track, in order. Omit for single-track topics with no journey.

footer.description: HTML shown under the checklists (fees, scheduling links).

sources.description: Authoritative sources the research verified. These feed the app library and the NotebookLM notebook.

gated.description: True when the source needs a login, membership or purchase.

localFile.description: Filename under data/docs/ when a copy ships with the app, else null.

url.description: Canonical URL, or null when the document is not public.

advancedPrefix.description: Domains starting with this prefix get the 'beyond the core' tag. Empty disables.

blurb.description: Dashboard intro copy. {questions} {cards} {guides} {drills} {track:ID} expand to live counts.

id.description: Storage namespace slug. Unique per app on the same site; never changes after launch.

name.description: Short app name shown in the header.

trackLabel.description: What a track is called in the UI: Certification, Level, Exam...

id.description: Track id used as every question's cert value.

prerequisite.description: Track id that must be held first, or null.

summary.description: One line: questions, minutes, who it is for.

title: Topic Research Dossier
